 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Return the top-left quadrant of the nonzero pattern's bounding box."""
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    if not rows or not cols:
        return []
    r0, r1 = rows[0], rows[-1] + 1
    c0, c1 = cols[0], cols[-1] + 1
    height, width = r1 - r0, c1 - c0
    return [grid[r0 + r][c0:c0 + width // 2] for r in range(height // 2)]
